race.title: Apres Village At Doncaster Racecourse 'Hands & Heels' Handicap Hurdle (Conditional/Amateurs)
race.verdict: A trappy race. BRIGHT LEGEND has fallen to a tempting mark and could capitalise if taking up this engagement. Hurdling debutant Sledgehammer has to be feared in his bid to make it 4-4 for Adrian Keatley, with front-running Biglesisback also expected to give a good account. BRIGHT LEGEND (IRE) SLEDGEHAMMER (IRE) BIGLESISBACK
race.bettingForecast: Sledgehammer (13/8), Biglesisback (7/2), Bright Legend (4/1), Vaguely Royal (6/1), Johnny Moonshine (7/1), Glitz And Glamour (16/1)
